en: Simple enough.
Your day is about to end badly.
Shall we see what purpose this serves?
I wonder what that could be for.
You'll pay for that!
No!

I thought I heard something.
Just my imagination, perhaps.
I'm quite ready to be rid of this place, I think.
Today is an excellent day to die!
Well, it's been good working with you.

Nonsense!
Focus, and we shall take them down!

I won't hear that talk!
We'll win if we work together!

Perhaps our chances would
improve without your attitude.
Still your tongue, fool!
It was bound to happen like this.
Well, what did you expect?

It looks like we have enough to last us for a little while now. Good news to be sure, but we mustn't rest on our laurels just yet. Those supplies won't last forever, and I assume this place is temporary at best.
Hmm? I thought we had a decent arrangement. You want me to go?
Good to see you. How goes it?
Hmm. Well alright, I'll stay. If you need anything from me, just say so.
I see. Well I'll be off then.
I cannot beat you!
Then I'll only face death at the hands of the next bastard who comes along! No deal!
I can't die over this. Take it and let me be!
I could never follow someone like you!
It's preferable to death I suppose. Fine, I am yours.
Very well.
Well then, let's be off!

I came here for much the same reason as you, no doubt, looking for supplies. I haven't found much yet, but I'm going to rest up and take it slow. I was nearly had by a monster back there, so I don't want to push it.
This place is dangerous. Be on your guard.
Now there's an idea. Many hands make light work as they say. Shall we?
I understand your reticence, and will not force the issue. Take care.

There's nothing quite like warming your bones by the fire, eh? After what we've been through, I'm lucky to have the chance. You know, I don't think I'd have made it this far without you backing me up, so thanks for that. Whatever happens from here on out, I just wanted you to know that you can count on me. Here's a little something as a show of faith.
Taking a break before the next run? Everybody's counting on you, so don't push yourself too hard. If you need me to help you with anything, just ask, and I'll be ready.
You mean for me to leave permanently, don't you?
How are you? Everything's fine here.
Is something the matter? If there's a problem, think it through and don't do something you might regret.
I had hoped to be useful, but I guess I didn't work hard enough. Good luck.
Great, I could use a little exercise!
Alright, who's first?
Someone go see what that is.
You see that?
You're next,  asshole!
Oh, fuck you!

This place is starting to get to me.
Can we finish up?
We have a good reason for being here, right?
Shit! They're too much!
Time to go down swinging!
Just let me take care of it!
No way! Just watch me!

Either shut up and help or
get out of the damn way!
Ugh, I'm sick of your damn whinging!
Saves me the trouble, I guess.
Fuck. Whatever.

So it's not quite the comforts of city life, but it has its charms. I get to crack heads whenever someone pisses me off, and no guards come running. Still, it's been a long while since I had a good drink. I wonder if we'll ever get off this shitpile island.
You want me to leave? After all that twisting my arm to get me here in the first place?
Nothing to report here.
Then why the hell are we talking about it?
Fine. I had you figured for a coward anyway.
Damn you! If you're going to put me down then do it already!
You're gonna have to pry it from my cold, dead fingers, asshole!
Take it then, and fuck off!
Fuck you, I'd rather die!
Well, you kicked my ass pretty good, so I guess I don't have much choice. Let's go.
Ah shit. I'm in no position to argue. I hope something else in here eats you.
Wait, you're actually serious? If you think you can actually score me some liquor and ass, sure, I'll tag along for a bit. Let's see where this goes.
Look, if you don't have some business with me you'd better get lost. And if your business is pissing me off, well... you're going to be real sorry you found me.
What the hell do you want?
Hah! You want me to join you? Sure, just hook me up with some liquor and a decent ass or two and we got a deal!
Like I said, get lost.

You know, back when I agreed to follow you, I never thought it would be like this. I eat better, and I sleep better since being with you. We got a thing that works, you know? Anyway, I just wanted to let you know that I think you're alright, and I'm more comfortable when I have you at my back. Thanks.

There was some ruckus a little earlier, but I sat 'em down and shut 'em up. Someone has to, right? Naw, I didn't hurt 'em, don't worry. They might be a bunch of scum, but they're the only crew we got in this place, and broken bones are no good for anyone when shit goes down. Anyway, did you need something?
You gotta be shitting me. After all that, you want me to just fuck off?
Hey there. All's well here.
If that was supposed to be a joke, it wasn't fucking funny.
Well, fuck you too. You'd better hope I never see you again.
Must we truly bother with this rabble?

You distract us from matters of greater import.
Begone.
That appears to be of some importance.
A curiosity.
Your vengeance comes hence!
Your death draws nigh, dog!
Such charming decor.
Is it really necessary for us to linger here?
You fool! You've led us to our demise!
Now we'll all die like vermin thanks to you!
Fear not. I will lead us to victory!
I'll brook no such dissent. Focus!
Of course a fool like you would say as much.
Is battle too grand a scheme for your simple mind?
Predictable.
Well, that's convenient.
Is this hovel really the best we can manage? Surely there's something a bit less damp we could be using instead? Something a bit less infested with vermin?
Are you suggesting that you'll be better off without me?
Oh, it's you. I assume you have a reason for bothering me?
Of course you wouldn't. Now don't talk such rot.
Honestly, it's a relief. I can scarcely stand the sight of you anymore.
I am brought down by the likes of you? Ugh.
A common criminal to the last. Go to hell!
I should have guessed a wretch like you would care for naught but wealth. Take it and be satisfied.
Submit to servitude? Never! You'll have to kill me!
Is this my fate? Toiling 'neath the boot of a thug? I have no resistance left. I am yours.
You'll wish you'd saved your pity for yourself.
Well then, let's see if we can't keep from irritating one another to death, hmm? Lead the way.

Well, at least you're smart enough not to draw weapons on me. It isn't much, but it's more than I expected. 
What is it that you want?
Keep away from me, criminal.
Though I may well retch at the thought of walking abreast rabble, I admit I am short on allies. Perhaps we can help one another.
On second thought, you're right, that would be most unbearable. Now, toddle off.

When you pressed me into service way back when, I admit I had you figured for a common rogue. I must say I entirely underestimated your competence, and I am most pleased at the surprise. It is only proper that I should present you with this as a congratulatory token. You have earned it.

If anything, it's a small wonder you've managed to hold this rabble together. Honestly, it's no wonder you want me around, surrounded with the worst sort such as you are, but we make the most of what's available, hmm?
That's preposterous! This lot will crumble without me. Are you serious?
Good day. Are you here to discuss business?
Well of course not. Surely you aren't so grand a fool.
Don't doubt for a moment that they'll all turn on you as soon as the last bastion of civility is gone. Mark my words.
To battle!
Victory awaits!
I wonder what purpose that serves.
Shall we take a look?
You will be avenged!
Come and meet your end, knave!
Everything looks fine here, for now.
Do you think there is anything to find here?
This may be our last battle.
Run! I'll hold them off!

You're being dramatic.
We will persevere!

You overestimate their strength.
Fear not!

Don't be such a fool.
We're stronger than you believe!

Lay down and die if it suits you.
I'll do no such thing!
Such strength!
An impressive adversary!
We've actually got something halfway civil here, haven't we? It's inspiring, really, to see the outcasts of society coming together like this. I'm pleased to be a part of it!
You mean to have me quit the group for good, is that it?
A fine day to you.
I am relieved! Is there some issue at hand I could help with?
Well, I'm disappointed but I'm sure you have your reasons. Take care of everyone, and farewell.
I yield! Mercy!
I won't be robbed like some hapless fool!
No possession is worth death. Take it and let me walk!
Never! I won't give you the satisfaction!
My pride or my life then? Very well. I will join you.
I will go immediately.
Marvellous! I shall follow your lead then.

Be careful of the lurking beasts. I've scarce set foot anywhere on this island without being harried by them. Worse yet, some places are holdouts for bandits, or trapped ruins. I am taking a moment here to assess my options before venturing further.
Well-met stranger.
You know, I was thinking just the same thing. Share in the toil, share in the spoils! What say you?
That is a shame, but I understand. It is difficult to trust anyone here.

You know, when I ended up here, I was certain that it was me against a horde, and there would be no companionship to be had. I am quite pleased to see that I was wrong on that. We are managing to make the best of a hopeless situation, bringing comfort and hope to the lost, and working with you in this has truly been a privilege. Take this, as a token of my esteem, and know that I gladly call you friend.

If we carry on the way things have been going, we'll have a proper community before long! With homes and shops and the whole lot. I wonder if we would be able to find a decent site for such a thing? Nevermind me though, I'm getting ahead of myself. What's on your mind?
What? I thought we were friends. Is this really what you want?
It's always a pleasure to see you.
If something is wrong, I will help you through it. Please trust me.
I'll go then. It's been my pleasure to work alongside you, and I wish you all the best.

A death for you,
and one for you!
Now to paint the floor in pretty red.
It doesn't do anything if we nothing do.
It says "touch me like you touch your lover".
Such a pretty sleep.
Breaking the thread is not allowed!
Tick, tock, tick, tock...

One plus one is me, me plus you is two,
you plus two is three...

The thread winds short.
Time's up!

Yes, make the voices stop!
Make everything stop!
So beautiful when you are wrong.

You are funny.
I won't let them cut the thread!
Stop screeching your stupid words!

A fistful of thread still, see?
Wind it 'round their necks, and yours too!
Take your stupid face and get in the ground!
Haha! Never come back!
No matter how hard I pinch, I never wake up. I'd better keep trying.
If I go, who will catch you when you slip?
A dream. Maybe it's a dream?
Yes, that's much better isn't it?
I tried, I tried.
Is all this blood... mine?
No no no no, it's my own! You can't have it!
Take it and see! Haha, oh, you'll see!
Not this close! No, cut the thread, cut the thread!
One end 'round your wrist, yes, wind it nice and tight. Don't let go, don't you dare.
Wind the spool a little longer, then. Yes, longer.
Oh, now you've done it. What if you slip? I won't let you fall, no.
You aren't allowed to leave now. Stay and talk. Use my ears and I will use your lips.
Pretty voices. Stay and sing for me.
Don't step down the path, lest the stones come loose and you can't return.
No, safer that way. Much safer.

The fire is so pretty. Hard to look away, but sometimes something else shines too, something glittering at the edge of seeing. Mostly I can't catch them, but this time, oh this time I caught one. It's for you. It will make you happy.
Maybe I can find some string? I can wind a pretty lace to make everyone happy. You'd like that, yes?
Oh, no it's not supposed to be like that, no.
It's quiet.
It's much better. Here, I'll make something pretty for you, you'll see.
I can feel it fraying. It won't be long now, no, not long.
No fuckin' problem.
We got this one.

Whaddaya think?
Should we mess with that?
What the fuck is that?
Aw shit, why'd it have to be you?
Hey, don't you dare leave me now!
Well, ain't this place charming?
I'm shakin' like a leaf here.
That's it, we're fucked.

In case we don't make it,
I love you.

None of that.
I'm here, ain't I?

Well it just gives me the chance to
show off for you, don't it?
Shut your trap, I ain't goin' down that easy.
Blah blah blah, shut up and fight.
Yeah, good riddance, asshole.

Anybody else want a drink?
I want a drink.

This is great, I ain't been around this many people since forever! 'Course I could do with a few more of 'em getting a bit closer, but at this point I'll take what company I can get.  Anyway, was there something you needed, or you just come by to fraternize? I'm good either way.
Aww, come on, really? I didn't do anything to deserve the boot, did I?
Well ain't you a sight for sore eyes?
Naw, I didn't think so. I'm just friendlier than most, you'll get used to it!
Just when things were starting to get good, too. Well, bye.
Ah, fuck me, you're strong.
Hey, fuck you, I need that!
It ain't worth dyin' over. Take it and let me go!
I don't work for nobody but me. You can take those terms and cram 'em up your arse!
Well shit, I'm in no position to argue. My ass is yours I guess.
Don't gotta tell me twice.
Music to my ears! How's about a hug to seal the deal? No? Later then.

Hey now, no need to be shy, I'm not in a biting mood just at the moment. You're lookin' pretty healthy, you ain't been here that long I guess? You know it sure does get lonely out here, struggling to survive all by yourself.
Hi, stranger. How's it going?
I thought you'd never ask! You make sure I don't get lonely and I'll do whatever you want. What do you say?
Ah well, it's a nice thought, but I'd rather be lonely and alone than lonely in a crowd. You take care now.

Hey. You know, the firelight has a way of highlighting all your best features. When we first met I never figured on how strong and reliable you'd be. I guess it just goes to show that sometimes you can't know all there is about someone just by lookin' at 'em, right? Well, you must know a thing or two about that, seein' as you keep me around even when I act the way I do. Take this, will you? Just a little something to remember me by, just in case.

Ain't it weirdly satisfying to be living like this? Away from all the rules and the expectations, just a bunch of jolly rejects clinging together for warmth in the dark of night. Did you like that? I'm a fuckin' poet.
Aww, don't say that to me now! Not when I'm this attached. Am I really that bad?
I was just thinking about you! How you doing?
Don't mess with me like that! I got feelings too, you know.
Well fuck. I kinda wish you'd just stabbed me. Now I gotta be alone and brokenhearted to boot. It's not fuckin' fair.
The fighting just never stops.
Come on then. I'll kill you all if I have to.
Oh good. Another thing to deal with.

Who knows what might happen?
We'd best not.
No!  It's all falling apart!
Oh God, no!
This place is singularly unpleasant.
Are you quite certain we need to be here?
This is it, then isn't it?

We're all going to die.
I knew this would happen!

I feel like that all the time, but it's not real!
Fight!
You don't really believe that!
We're not that weak! We're not!
Don't say that, you're scaring me!
That... that's okay, right?
Better you than... anyone, really.

So are we going to keep bringing in more people? I shudder to think of what some of them did to get here. What a wretched place to end up, being forced to rely on a lot such as this. 
Sorry, did you need something?
Ah. I must admit, I've thought of leaving myself. Do you want me to go?
Well, we aren't dead yet. That's something.
I suppose I'll stay on for the time being then.
My things are already packed. You don't mind if I fill up my waterskin first, right?
I can't take this anymore.
That's what my life is worth? Just finish me off.
Alright, take it. If I die, it will be worthless anyway.
I'd rather die than toil under your thumb. Just end this!
Work for you? Do I even have a choice, really?
Do you think you're being kind? There's no kindness here. Remember that.
Well, lead the way then. We'll see how this goes.

I don't want any of this. I had a home and a life, and now it's all gone. Now I'm reduced to hiding in cellars and scrounging for food unfit for swine. Maybe I'd be better off to have stayed in the stocks.
Just stay away from me, please.
Go with you? I don't think that's a good idea. Then again, I don't think being alone in this place is a good idea either. I suppose I'll come along, just for a while.
Yes, well as I said, it's probably not a good idea. I don't know you.

Since we've met, I think you've put on some weight. That is, you're doing well, thriving even. You've put together a group of the most rotten people I can imagine and managed to make something liveable out of it. I don't know how much help I've been along the way, but I know that I'm better off in your company than out of it, and... I wanted to thank you for having me. Please, take this.

I began talking with some of the others recently. Some are unapologetic scum of course, but some of them claim to be innocent, and some are guilty of things I didn't even realize were crimes. Some should have received a paltry fine instead of exile. I'm not sure what's going on, but there's something that smells quite wrong about all of this.
You want me to leave? After everything we've been through? Are you quite sure?
Things are quiet for the moment.
Testing my committment then? Don't worry, I'm not going to go anywhere.
Well, I knew it was only a matter of time, I suppose.

Deep breath.
We've been through worse.
Okay, focus.
Do you think we should touch that?
I'm not sure this is safe.
Oh God, I'm next, aren't I?
No no no no!
I... I thought I heard something just now.
